compiled_state.title: [merge-to-main-pr]: PR merges complete -> plugin.json version not bumped
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 2929f94ae69195199bedf53fece942ae94dcfd5e
* **plugin.json version:** 1.16.11
* **merge.strategy:** pr

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

`plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh` invokes `_phase_version_bump` after PR merge (line 2064), which should bump `plugins/dso/.claude-plugin/plugin.json` `version` field and produce a `chore: bump version to vX.Y.Z` commit on each successful PR merge — equivalent to the direct-merge behavior. Each merged PR should advance the plugin version so `/plugin` reports a fresh version.

#### Actual Behavior

`/plugin` reports `dso is already at the latest version (1.16.11)` after at least 5 consecutive PR merges (#98, #99, #100, #101, #102) since 2026-05-10. `git log --all --oneline | grep "bump version"` shows the most recent bump was `8da393be67 chore: bump version to v1.16.11 and advance stable channel (#48)` — well before the recent PR-merge wave. No `chore: bump version` commits appear in the log for PRs #90, #92, #94, #96, #98, #99, #100, #101, #102.

### 3. Action History

1. Multiple PR-based merges to main between PR #48 (last version bump) and PR #102 (HEAD).
2. User ran `/plugin` at 2026-05-12 and observed stale version 1.16.11.
3. Inspected `plugins/dso/.claude-plugin/plugin.json` — still 1.16.11.

### 4. Chronological Rationalization

`merge-to-main-pr.sh` sources `merge-to-main-direct.sh` as a library and calls `_phase_version_bump` after PR merge. The phase appears to run silently without bumping, or fails without surfacing an error to the user, or the amend/push of the bump commit is being skipped in PR mode. Root cause not yet diagnosed — see §6.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* `/dso:commit` → `merge-to-main.sh` → `merge-to-main-pr.sh` (since `merge.strategy=pr`)
* Direct-mode path: `merge-to-main-direct.sh` has `--bump` flag and `_phase_version_bump`; PR path reuses these.

### 6. Logs

No automated logs captured; symptom is the absence of bump commits in `git log`:

```
$ git log --all --oneline | grep "bump version" | head -3
a2c9831740 Merge pull request #60 from navapbc/release/v1.16.11
8da393be67 chore: bump version to v1.16.11 and advance stable channel (#48)
2b7f5b1e89 chore: bump version to v1.16.11 and advance stable channel
```

Investigation hints (not root cause):
- `_phase_version_bump` may require `version.file_path` in `.claude/dso-config.conf` and silently skip if absent.
- PR mode comment at line 2042 says "version_bump runs against the merged commit on origin/main" — push of the resulting amended commit may not be wired in PR mode.
